theorems.name: Submission.section3_antilipschitzOn_volume_le_euclideanHausdorff_image
theorems.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn p) (S : Set (Rn n)) (K : ℝ≥0), (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖x - y‖ ≤ K * ‖f x - f y‖) → volume S ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * μHE[n] (f '' S)
